Command.Statement: SELECT Hierarchize({DrilldownLevel({[ZCLDIAG.ZCLDIAG_ICD].[All Diagnoses by ICD-10 Chapter]},,,INCLUDE_CALC_MEMBERS)}) DIMENSION PROPERTIES PARENT_UNIQUE_NAME ON COLUMNS FROM (SELECT ({[ZCLDIAG.ZCLDIAG_ICD].[DIAGNOSES].[RESPIRATORY].[UPPER_RESPIRATORY_INFECTIONS]}) ON COLUMNS FROM [ZCLVISIT]) WHERE ([Measures].[ZCLVISNO]) CELL PROPERTIES VALUE, FORMAT_STRING, LANGUAGE, BACK_COLOR, FORE_COLOR, FONT_FLAGS
